definitions: A conception of or belief about something.
A general understanding; a vague or imperfect conception or idea of something.
An impulse or desire, especially one of a whimsical or eccentric kind.
A small, often trivial, article or item, especially one used in sewing (chiefly North American).
examples: I had no notion of what she meant.
She had a vague notion of what was happening.
He took a notion to go for a walk.
She bought some notions for her craft project.
